solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Company's grouse about not entirely polite person, much-travelled?

parts.note: Co is the usual abbreviation for company, with the 's kept

indicators.note: the complaint wraps itself around the shortened word

parts.note: to grouse is to complain or moan

indicators.note: the word polite is not given in full: its final letter is dropped

explanation.surface: A firm sniffs at someone who is not quite polite but has seen the world.
explanation.walkthrough: 'grouse' looks like the bird but is a verb meaning complain; 'about' wraps it around the shortened word.
explanation.definitionFit: A cosmopolitan is a worldly figure familiar with many countries, a well-travelled sophisticate.

clue.text: Unpleasant task in branch or elsewhere

indicators.note: the letters sit inside the run of words branch or elsewhere

explanation.surface: A tiresome job awaits at the local branch or some other office.
explanation.definitionFit: A routine, tedious duty such as housework is the classic disagreeable job.

clue.text: Southern headland attack — he's blamed unfairly

parts.note: a cape is a headland jutting into the sea
to go at someone is to attack them

explanation.surface: A southern promontory is assaulted, and someone takes the blame he doesn't deserve.
explanation.definitionFit: A fall guy who carries the blame for others' faults is the classic whipping boy.

clue.text: Too sure of oneself for novice, tend to be mistaken

indicators.note: the letters of for novice tend are taken wrongly, so they come out in another order

explanation.surface: A beginner tends to get things wrong through being cocky.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to be mistaken' rearranges the thirteen letters of FOR NOVICE TEND.
explanation.definitionFit: Being excessively self-assured means having more certainty in your own ability than is warranted.

clue.text: Harp on about deprived child?

indicators.note: the letters of harp on are turned about into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone keeps going on and on about a needy youngster.
explanation.definitionFit: A child who has lost both parents has been deprived of them, the sense the question mark flags.

clue.text: Some ninon these Cretans can display having been tipped off?

indicators.note: Some says the answer is only part of the run of words that follows
the words ninon these Cretans show the letters inside them

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Cretan women wearing ninon, a sheer fabric, may show they've been let in on something.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft took 'can display having been tipped off' as the definition, but 'can display' joins 'Some' in signalling the hidden run; the definition is 'having been tipped off'. Ninon is a fine silk or voile.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who has been tipped off has private knowledge shared with only a few, an idiom for being informed.

clue.text: That's surprising — bathmat oddly missing

indicators.note: the first, third, fifth and seventh letters of bathmat are taken away, leaving the even ones

explanation.surface: Someone exclaims on finding the bath mat has strangely vanished.
explanation.definitionFit: The interjection expresses sudden discovery or surprise, as when something unexpected is noticed.

clue.text: Referring to man, monarch's stand-in

parts.note: re means regarding or referring to
a gent is a gentleman, a man

explanation.surface: Talking about a fellow who deputises for the king.
explanation.definitionFit: One who governs on behalf of a sovereign who is a minor or incapacitated deputises for the throne.

clue.text: Old container, English, egg-shaped

parts.note: a vat is a large container for liquids

explanation.surface: An antique English vessel shaped like an egg.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective describes an oval outline wider at one end, like a hen's egg.

clue.text: Will's involved in this legal process?

definitions.text: Will's involved in this legal process?

parts.words: Will's involved in this legal process?
parts.note: read plainly it asks whether Will is caught up in a court matter; cryptically a last testament is what this procedure deals with

explanation.surface: Is someone called Will mixed up in a lawsuit?
explanation.walkthrough: 'Will' looks like a man's name, but it is a testament, which this court procedure validates.
explanation.definitionFit: The court procedure that proves a dead person's testament valid concerns a will by definition.

clue.text: Heard second person's sheep

indicators.note: heard says the word is taken as spoken, not as written

explanation.surface: Someone overheard that the sheep belongs to another person.
explanation.definitionFit: A female sheep has its own name, as a cow does among cattle.

clue.text: Having changed a lot since land seen from sea

indicators.note: the letters of a lot since have been altered into a fresh order

explanation.surface: The view from the water has altered greatly over the years.
explanation.definitionFit: Sailors see the shore's outline, where the land meets the water, as they approach.

clue.text: Bet inn air could become intoxicating

indicators.note: the letters of bet inn air may be turned into something else by reordering

explanation.surface: A wager that the pub's atmosphere will turn heady.
explanation.definitionFit: As an adjective the word means causing drunkenness, the same as intoxicating.

clue.text: Top bird, northern

parts.note: a crow is a black bird

explanation.surface: The best bird comes from the north.
explanation.definitionFit: The highest part of a head, hill or hat is called this, a synonym for the summit.

clue.text: Upset Catholic, Italian, I initially considered a fault-finder

indicators.note: in a down clue upset turns the letters for Catholic upside down, reading upward
only the opening letter of considered is used

explanation.surface: An offended Italian Catholic regards someone as a nitpicker.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who judges and points out flaws is a censorious reviewer or carper.

clue.text: Choose ends like every captain, toss at first

indicators.note: the opening letter of each of the words ends like every captain toss is taken

explanation.surface: Every captain picks which end to defend once the coin toss is won.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket and football the captain winning the toss picks ends or innings.
explanation.definitionFit: To pick by vote or decision, as when a party votes in its leader, means to choose.

clue.text: Pruned around top of tulips and separated

indicators.note: the trimmed word goes around the letter taken from tulips

parts.note: pared means trimmed or cut back, as when pruning

indicators.note: in a down clue the top of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A gardener cut back around the tulips and divided them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'around' puts T, the first letter of tulips, inside PARED.
explanation.definitionFit: Things divided or split apart from each other have gone their separate ways.

clue.text: Difficult to understand — certain it must be rewritten

indicators.note: the letters of certain it are written out again in a different order

explanation.surface: An editor is sure a convoluted passage needs redrafting.
explanation.definitionFit: Something elaborate with many interwoven parts is complicated and hard to follow.

clue.text: Manage to flee

definitions.meaning: to manage a business is to be in charge of operating it
to flee is to make off at speed

explanation.surface: Someone succeeds in getting away.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb covers both operating a business and bolting from danger, two everyday senses.

clue.text: New house after revolution in French city

indicators.note: the word for house is read the other way round once it has been turned

parts.note: a semi is a semi-detached house, one sharing a wall with its neighbour

explanation.surface: A new home after the revolution, somewhere in France.
explanation.walkthrough: A semi, short for semi-detached, is a common British house type sharing one wall with its neighbour; 'after revolution' turns it round.
explanation.definitionFit: This Roman city in the Gard department of southern France is famous for its arena.

clue.text: Examine closely popular page penned by religious group

indicators.note: the page letter is enclosed, as if in a pen, by the group

parts.note: a sect is a religious faction

explanation.surface: A trendy page written by members of a faith gets scrutinised.
explanation.definitionFit: To look at something carefully, checking for faults, is to scrutinise it.

clue.text: Child, second, performing

parts.note: a performer on stage is on

explanation.surface: A second child goes on stage.
explanation.definitionFit: A male offspring is someone's boy, a particular kind of child.

clue.text: True masculine field of study

parts.note: M is the grammatical abbreviation for masculine

explanation.surface: A genuinely manly area of academic work.
explanation.definitionFit: A domain or sphere of knowledge, such as the world of physics, is a kingdom of thought.

clue.text: Country diet aunt sets out

indicators.note: the letters of diet aunt sets are put out of their order

explanation.surface: An aunt lays out her diet plan.
explanation.definitionFit: The federal republic of fifty states in North America is a nation, the USA.
